# Synthetic atlas volume pack v1

This fixture is generated by `tools/build_volume_fixture.py`. It contains no
Allen voxel data: the template is an axis-coded ramp and the annotation is six
voxels referencing the existing five-row synthetic region catalog. Both the
generator and generated data are released under this repository's MIT license.

The deliberately off-grid ML origin makes source index `2` a right-hemisphere
voxel at world ML `-39 um`. This protects iblatlas' explicit
`first_right_index` rule from being incorrectly replaced by a world-coordinate
sign test.

Regenerate from the repository root:

```console
python tools/build_volume_fixture.py tests/fixtures/volume-pack-v1/pack
```
